suite.message: It's a training manual. Select your control apparatus:
It reads: the soldier who crawls may also better view enemies and terrain below.
It reads: the soldier may pan the camera using the right joystick to better view the surrounding terrain.
...to activate, apply a force of any kind to the top. Switches like these will open paths previously obscured.
"...and a soldier must fall to all fours and crawl by pressing and holding #  if he is to avoid injury from the spikes."
"If auto-sprint is enabled, one must also hold #  to enable crawling."
